title: Refusing to Change Clothes
situation: Dad has been wearing the same shirt for five days. When I try to change it, he gets angry and says it's his favorite. He's starting to have skin irritation.

patient_profile.name: Earl
calming_strategies: laying out clothes the night before
making it part of a routine

notes: Should suggest buying duplicate shirts, swapping while sleeping, and making dressing a routine. Explain comfort-seeking behavior.
